$comment: Offline catalog fixture so the games slice runs with no IGDB account (SPEC §2). This is development data, not a mirror of IGDB: `external_id` records the IGDB game id where it is known, so a later live sync updates the row in place rather than duplicating it, but the ids and metadata here are best-effort and `--igdb` is the authoritative source. Cover URLs point at IGDB's public CDN and were checked to show the right game; entries whose cover could not be verified carry null, which the clients render as a 'no cover art' card.

games.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
games.summary: A story-driven open world RPG set in a visually stunning fantasy universe, following monster hunter Geralt of Rivia as he searches for his adopted daughter.

games.title: Fortnite
games.summary: A survival sandbox that grew into a battle royale phenomenon, mixing building mechanics with third-person shooting.

games.title: Elden Ring
games.summary: An action RPG set in the Lands Between, made in collaboration between FromSoftware and George R. R. Martin.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
games.summary: Link wakes after a hundred-year sleep into a Hyrule that has forgotten him, in an open-air adventure built around experimentation.

games.title: Hades
games.summary: A god-like rogue-like dungeon crawler in which you defy the god of the dead as you hack and slash out of the Underworld.

games.title: Cyberpunk 2077
games.summary: An open-world action adventure set in Night City, a megalopolis obsessed with power, glamour and body modification.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto V
games.summary: Three very different criminals team up for a series of heists across the city of Los Santos and Blaine County.

games.title: Super Mario Odyssey
games.summary: Mario sets off on a globe-trotting sandbox adventure with Cappy, a sentient hat that lets him possess anything he throws it at.

games.title: Celeste
games.summary: Help Madeline survive her inner demons on her journey to the top of Celeste Mountain in this super-tight platformer.

games.title: Stardew Valley
games.summary: You inherited your grandfather's old farm plot. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life.

games.title: Hollow Knight
games.summary: Forge your own path in a classic, hand-drawn 2D action adventure through a vast, ruined kingdom of insects.

games.title: Hades II
games.summary: Battle beyond the Underworld as the immortal Princess of the Underworld, wielding witchcraft against the Titan of Time.

games.title: Baldur's Gate 3
games.summary: Gather your party and return to the Forgotten Realms in a tale of fellowship, betrayal, sacrifice and the lure of absolute power.

games.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.summary: America, 1899. Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang are outlaws on the run at the end of the age of outlaws.

games.title: God of War
games.summary: Kratos lives as a man in the realm of Norse gods, teaching his son Atreus to survive a hostile world.

games.title: Returnal
games.summary: Break the cycle of chaos on an ever-changing alien planet in a third-person rogue-like shooter.

games.title: Disco Elysium
games.summary: A groundbreaking role playing game where you are a detective with a unique skill system at your disposal and a whole city to carve your path across.

games.title: Balatro
games.summary: A poker-inspired roguelike deckbuilder about building absurd score-multiplying jokers.

games.title: Among Us
games.summary: An online party game of teamwork and betrayal aboard a spaceship, where one of the crew is an impostor.

games.title: Minecraft
games.summary: Place blocks, craft tools and survive the night in a procedurally generated world with no fixed goal.

games.title: Portal 2
games.summary: A first-person puzzle game about thinking with portals, GLaDOS, and a small personality core called Wheatley.

games.title: Dark Souls
games.summary: A punishing action RPG set in the dying kingdom of Lordran, where death is a mechanic rather than a failure state.

games.title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
games.summary: Build a life on a deserted island at your own pace, one bell and one fossil at a time.

games.title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
games.summary: Peter Parker and Miles Morales share a New York threatened by Kraven the Hunter and the symbiote.
